title: How to Find the Best Undervalued Deals (For Beginners)
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
promo_conflict: The host demonstrates specific named tools (Outscraper, SearchBug, Sly Broadcast, Message Media, Porterhouse), which may be affiliate links. He also promotes his own newsletter and fund. No deal closes on camera, so the lead-gen numbers are first-hand but the outcomes aren't shown.

idea.name: Off-market RV park acquisition via scraped leads + cold texting
idea.one_liner: Scrape Google Maps for RV park owners, check which numbers are mobiles, mass-text them to start conversations, then call to buy parks below a 10% cap rate, ideally with seller financing.
idea.customer: Sellers: independent RV/mobile home park owners (the buyer is the founder/investor)
idea.revenue_model: Net operating income from owned parks plus value growth; buy at 10%+ cap rate

key_quotes.quote: And the more leads you reach out to, the higher the chance of getting 100% seller financing where you put no money down.
Those are pretty good because a lot of times those are very under the radar parks.
The best results come when you're willing to play the long game and just seek to start a conversation on the first message
If I were local, I would put the word here cuz that makes all the difference.
if I if I engage in text with people about the campground, it seems like I'm texting for weeks and I really don't have time for that.

acquisition_channels.details: Not a valid channel; see other
Bulk SMS through a texting platform (Message Media; SlyText/Porterhouse also suggested) to scraped owner mobiles, personalised with the city name and opening with a conversational message
Phones interested replies from his personal iPhone after researching the park's website and social media
Google Maps scraping with Outscraper (Reonomy suggested as a real-estate-first alternative); unverified listings targeted as under-the-radar parks; ringless voicemail provider used to check numbers

ideas.delivery: The founder scrapes, cleans and checks leads in Google Sheets, texts in bulk, follows up by hand and calls to negotiate. Parks are then owned and run (managers or owner-operators).

tools: Sly Broadcast (ringless voicemail / free number validation)

uk_legal_risk.reason: Acquisition relies on unsolicited bulk SMS (and ringless voicemail) to park owners, many of whom are individuals, families or sole traders. PECR bans this in the UK without prior consent. Follow-up cold calls would also need TPS/CTPS screening.

ideas.other_uk_rules: UK GDPR applies to scraping and storing owners' personal mobile numbers and names (lawful basis, privacy notice, right to object). UK caravan/holiday park site licensing (Caravan Sites and Control of Development Act 1960) and the Mobile Homes Act 1983 apply to the assets.
